highlights: Result Update 04th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 415 Happiest Minds Technologies Ltd IT Services Sector 1 Steady Quarter; Proposed Merger to Create Synergy Benefits Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – INLINE; EBIT Margin – INLINE ; PAT – MISS Change in Estimates YoY post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 0.1%/0.2%; EBIT: 1.6%/0.5%, PAT: 0.3%/1.6% Recommendation Rationale • AI Adoption Enhancing Productivity and Client Outcomes: Happiest Minds is increasingly embedding AI across its delivery model through its internal programme such as Project Reimagine.
Its Generative AI Business Services unit delivered 135% YoY CC growth in H1FY27, indicating rising customer demand.

Platforms such as RelaiBuild, Ellipse and SecGenie are also gaining traction, with RelaiBuild deployed across ~15 existing clients and Ellipse serving 21 customers. • IP-Led Revenue and Annuity Services Supporting Growth: The contribution of IP-led revenue increased to 10.5% of total revenue in Q2 vs 9.3% in Q1.
valuation: Result Update 04th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 415 Happiest Minds Technologies Ltd IT Services Sector 1 Steady Quarter; Proposed Merger to Create Synergy Benefits Est.
The combined entity is targeting US$1 Bn in annual revenue by FY28.
Current Valuation: 22x Sep’27E EPS (Earlier Valuation: 22x Jun’27E EPS) Current TP: Rs 415/share (Unchanged) Recommendation: We maintain our BUY rating on the stock.
watch: Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: Happiest Minds aims to deliver double-digit growth in constant currency for the year while maintaining EBITDA margins in the 20%-22% range (including other income).
Amid global headwinds, the company aims for above-industry growth, with resilient demand across its key verticals and integration of AI.
